registration_record: Commit this file before any training; the commit timestamp is the authoritative preregistration time.
experiment: PI-EGNN replaces the plain MMSE-initialized GNN as bank slot three

dataset.test_conditions: SNR {10,15,20} dB x velocity {30,120,500} km/h; 15 test samples per condition

architecture.graph: existing bipartite graph and 0.01 * max(abs(H_hat)) active-edge threshold
architecture.initialization: MMSE symbol estimate, preserving the original GNN initialization
architecture.prior_iteration_rationale: Validation-only 3/5/10 iteration results in prior_iteration_sanity.json are statistically indistinguishable; iterations beyond 3 showed no observed accuracy benefit, so 3 is locked as the simplest setting. This is not a speed-tradeoff claim.
architecture.effective_variance: For W = alpha (H_hat^H H_hat + sigma^2 I)^-1 H_hat^H, alpha = n / Re tr(W0 H_hat), W = alpha W0, z_t = x_(t-1) + W(y - H_hat x_(t-1)); tau_t = max(eps, mean_k |z_t,k - x_(t-1),k|^2 + sigma^2 mean_ij |Re[(W W^H)_ij]|). This matches the repository analytical OAMP variance calculation.
architecture.reliability: rho_t = sigma^2 / (sigma^2 + tau_t), broadcast to symbol nodes; bounded in [0,1] and larger for a smaller effective variance relative to configured noise.
architecture.qpsk_confidence: For Q = {(+/-1 +/- j)/sqrt(2)}, p(q|z_t,i) = exp(-|z_t,i-q|^2/tau_t) / sum_(q' in Q) exp(-|z_t,i-q'|^2/tau_t); confidence_i = max_(q in Q) p(q|z_t,i).
architecture.attention: Learned bidirectional softmax weights over active bipartite edges only; inactive edges receive exactly zero weight. Complexity is linear in active edge count for fixed feature width; this is sparse local attention, not a literal Linformer projection.

success_bar.first: PI-EGNN must have lower overall test BER, SER, and NMSE than the original MMSE-initialized GNN.
success_bar.second: PI-EGNN must have lower overall test BER, SER, and NMSE than OAMP-DL, or lower BER, SER, and NMSE in every condition of at least one pre-registered regime.
success_bar.uncertainty: Report per-condition receiver CI95 and paired PI-EGNN-minus-reference CI95. The pre-registered pass/fail comparison remains the strict per-condition mean comparison; paired intervals are also flagged as evidence and do not silently alter the success criterion.

artifacts: All PI-EGNN checkpoints, metrics, and diagnostic outputs go under experiments/pi_egnn; existing experiment artifacts are read-only.
